full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 87 S. 10 June 2010 MR. JOJO D. PATRON Administrative Assistant V Office of the Vice-Governor Aklan Dear Mr. Patron: 2010 This has reference to your earlier letter asking for a copy of this Department's legal opinion on the scope of the signing authority of the Provincial Vice-Governor. In this regard, we are furnishing you a photocopy of DILG Opinion No. series of '2005. In the said legal opinion, we opined that the local vice chief executive has the power to sign checks/warrants and disbursement vouchers relative to all expenditures appropriated for the operation of the Sanggunian and the Office of the local vice chief executive. Thank you and warm regards. Ls/17 (341 Very truly yours, ATTY. JESUS DOQ Director III
